package tech

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateTechInput holds update data.
type UpdateTechInput struct {
	ID    int
	Label string
}

// UpdateTech updates tech label.
type UpdateTech struct {
	Techs repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle updates tech.
func (uc UpdateTech) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateTechInput) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	tech, err := uc.Techs.GetByID(ctx, in.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	tech.Label = in.Label
	if err := uc.Techs.Update(ctx, *tech); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return tech, nil
}
